description: Proposed first floor extension of the existing office building with cycle and bin storage
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be commenced not later than three years from the date of this permission.
Reason:-
To comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the following approved drawings:
Reason:-
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

All new external finishes shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building(s) to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings hereby approved.
Reason:-
To ensure that the appearance of the proposed development is harmonious with the surrounding built environment, in accordance with Policy 26 of the Havering Local Plan.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order, the building shall only be used for purposes falling within Schedule 2, Part A, Class E(g)(i) (Offices to carry out operational or administrative functions) of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) and for no other purpose, including any other purpose within Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended). For the avoidance of doubt, change of use to residential under the General Permitted Development Order is not permitted.
Reason:-

To restrict the use to those compatibility-assessed parameters, protecting neighbouring residential amenity from inappropriate noise or disturbance and safeguarding local highway network capacity, in accordance with Policies 7, 23, and 34 of the Havering Local Plan.

The commercial use of the first-floor office extension hereby permitted shall only operate between the hours of 07:30 to 19:00 Monday to Friday, and 08:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays, and at no time on Sundays, Bank, or Public Holidays.
Reason:-
To protect the amenity of surrounding residential occupiers, in accordance with Policies 7 and 34 of the Havering Local Plan.

Prior to the first occupation of the extended first-floor facilities, any first-floor windows on the southern elevation facing towards the rear boundaries of Nos. 1,3 and 5 Howard Road shall be fitted with obscure glazing (minimum Level 3 privacy) and non-opening up to a height of 1.7 metres above internal finished floor level and shall be permanently retained as such thereafter.
Reason:-
To prevent direct overlooking and safeguard the privacy and living conditions of neighbouring residential occupiers, in accordance with Policy 7 of the Havering Local Plan.

All building operations in connection with the construction of external walls, roof, and foundations; site excavation or other external site works; works involving the use of plant or machinery; the erection of scaffolding; the delivery of materials; the removal of materials and spoil from the site, and the playing of amplified music shall only take place between the hours of 8.00am and 6.00pm Monday to Friday, and between 8.00am and 1.00pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Bank Holidays/Public Holidays.
Reason:-
To protect residential amenity.
